boundary_transform.effect: column support S_j becomes S_j minus the gauge monomial, so a role support can be reduced by any monomial it contains
boundary_transform.endpoint: the gauge is a product of stage letters, the same cheap-factor class the base uses
boundary_transform.kind: monomial gauge: each shrunk role is multiplied by a product of stage letters
boundary_transform.operator_unchanged: the gauge is an invertible diagonal monomial map, so it changes the role basis and not the operator action

superseded_because: factor search whose PASS_INVOICED_MAIN_CENSUS used a non-dividing monomial
what_this_does_not_show: that the replayed physical chain already sits in this gauge basis; the chain must be emitted in the shrunk basis for the price to attach to it directly
